acid_splash.name: Acid Splash
acid_splash.description: You hurl a bubble of acid at one or two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage. Damage increases by 1d6 at levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

blade_ward.name: Blade Ward
blade_ward.description: You can take a Reaction when you are hit by an attack roll to impose a 1d4 penalty on the attack roll, potentially turning the hit into a miss.

chill_touch.name: Chill Touch
chill_touch.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage and can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn. Damage increases by 1d10 at levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

dancing_lights.name: Dancing Lights
dancing_lights.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm)
dancing_lights.description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air.

druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
druidcraft.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create a tiny sensory effect, predict the weather for 24 hours, make a flower blossom or seed pod open, or light/snuff a small campfire.

eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch_blast.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage. The spell creates more beams at higher levels: two beams at level 5, three beams at level 11, and four beams at level 17.

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. Damage increases by 1d10 at levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

friends.name: Friends
friends.description: You have Advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn't hostile toward you.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

light.name: Light
light.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)
light.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

mage_hand.name: Mage Hand
mage_hand.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

mending.name: Mending
mending.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin.

message.name: Message
message.components: V, S, M (a short piece of copper wire)
message.description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

minor_illusion.name: Minor Illusion
minor_illusion.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. If a creature uses its action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

poison_spray.name: Poison Spray
poison_spray.description: You extend your hand and project a puff of noxious gas toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 Poison damage. Damage increases by 1d12 at levels 5 (2d12), 11 (3d12), and 17 (4d12).

prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
prestidigitation.description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice: create a minor sensory effect, light or snuff a candle/torch, clean or soil an object, chill/warm/flavor nonliving material, make a small mark, or create a nonmagical trinket.

produce_flame.name: Produce Flame
produce_flame.description: A flickering flame appears in your hand shedding bright light in a 20ft radius. You can hurl the flame at a creature within 60 feet as a Magic action (ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 Fire damage). Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice.

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw. Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
shillelagh.components: V, S, M (mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff)
shillelagh.description: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes 1d8 (Force damage). Damage die scales at level 5 (1d10), 11 (1d12), 17 (2d6).

shocking_grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking_grasp.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target (Advantage if target is wearing metal armor). On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. Damage increases by 1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

spare_the_dying.name: Spare the Dying
spare_the_dying.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 Hit Points. The creature becomes Stable.

thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
thaumaturgy.description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power: boom your voice 3x louder, cause flames to flicker/brighten/dim, cause harmless tremors, create an instantaneous sound, open or slam unlocked doors/windows, or alter the appearance of your eyes.

true_strike.name: True Strike
true_strike.components: S, M (a weapon with which you have proficiency)
true_strike.description: Guided by a flash of magical insight, you make one attack with the weapon used in the spell's casting. You can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls. If the attack hits, the target takes radiant damage instead of physical damage. Deals extra 1d6 radiant damage at level 5 (1d6), 11 (2d6), 17 (3d6).

vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious_mockery.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. Damage increases by 1d4 at levels 5 (2d4), 11 (3d4), and 17 (4d4).

alarm.name: Alarm
alarm.components: V, S, M (a tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire)
alarm.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion in a 20-foot cube. Choose audible (60ft bell) or mental (ping within 1 mile).

animal_friendship.name: Animal Friendship
animal_friendship.components: V, S, M (a morsel of food)
animal_friendship.description: This spell lets you convince a Beast that you mean it no harm. Target makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed by you.

armor_of_agathys.name: Armor of Agathys
armor_of_agathys.components: V, S, M (a cup of water)
armor_of_agathys.description: A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as a spectral frost. You gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 5 Cold damage. Upcasting: +5 Temp HP and +5 Cold damage per slot level above 1.

arms_of_hadar.name: Arms of Hadar
arms_of_hadar.description: Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you. Each creature in range makes a Strength save or takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until its next turn. Upcasting: +1d6 damage per slot level above 1.

bane.name: Bane
bane.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
bane.description: Up to three creatures of your choice within range must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it must subtract 1d4 from the result. Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 1.

bless.name: Bless
bless.components: V, S, M (a sprinkling of holy water)
bless.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw. Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 1.

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Upcasting: +1d6 fire damage per slot level above 1.

charm_person.name: Charm Person
charm_person.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw (with Advantage if in combat). If it fails, it is Charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 1.

color_spray.name: Color Spray
color_spray.components: V, S, M (a pinch of powder or sand that is colored red, yellow, and blue)
color_spray.description: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. Creatures in a 15ft cone make a CON save or gain the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.

command.name: Command
command.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, or Halt. Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 1.

compelled_duel.name: Compelled Duel
compelled_duel.description: You attempt to compel a creature into a duel. Target makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and cannot move more than 30 feet away from you.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.description: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. (2024 buff from 1d8 to 2d8). Upcasting: +2d8 healing per slot level above 1.

detect_magic.name: Detect Magic
detect_magic.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you and learn its school of magic.

disguise_self.name: Disguise Self
disguise_self.description: You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends or until you use an action to dismiss it.

dissonant_whispers.name: Dissonant Whispers
dissonant_whispers.description: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature within range can hear. The target must make a Wisdom save, taking 3d6 Psychic damage on a failure and must immediately use its Reaction to move as far as its speed allows away from you. Upcasting: +1d6 psychic damage per slot level above 1.

divine_smite.name: Divine Smite
divine_smite.description: Immediately after hitting a target with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, you expend a spell slot to deal extra 2d8 Radiant damage (or 3d8 vs Fiends/Undead). Upcasting: +1d8 radiant damage per slot level above 1. (2024 revised to Bonus Action spell).

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or gain the Restrained condition.

faerie_fire.name: Faerie Fire
faerie_fire.description: Each object in a 20-foot cube is outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Creatures in the area make a DEX save or are outlined; attack rolls against an outlined creature have Advantage, and it can't benefit from being Invisible.

feather_fall.name: Feather Fall
feather_fall.components: V, M (a small feather or piece of down)
feather_fall.description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet.

find_familiar.name: Find Familiar
find_familiar.components: V, S, M (10 GP worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs)
find_familiar.description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.

fog_cloud.name: Fog Cloud
fog_cloud.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

goodberry.name: Goodberry
goodberry.components: V, S, M (a sprig of mistletoe)
goodberry.description: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its bonus action to eat one berry, restoring 1 Hit Point and providing enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has Advantage. Upcasting: +1d6 radiant damage per slot level above 1.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. (2024 buff from 1d4 to 2d4). Upcasting: +2d4 healing per slot level above 1.

hellish_rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
hellish_rebuke.description: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Upcasting: +1d10 fire damage per slot level above 1.

heroism.name: Heroism
heroism.description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being Frightened and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns.

hex.name: Hex
hex.components: V, S, M (the petrified eye of a newt)
hex.description: You place a curse on a creature within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack, and choose one ability: target has Disadvantage on ability checks made with that ability. Upcasting: 8 hours at level 3, 24 hours at level 5.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have Advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it. (2024 deals Force damage). Upcasting: Up to 24 hours at higher levels.

identify.name: Identify
identify.components: V, S, M (a pearl worth at least 100 GP and an owl feather)
identify.description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement, and how many charges it has.

inflict_wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict_wounds.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 2d10 Necrotic damage and Constitution save or disadvantage on its next attack. Upcasting: +1d10 necrotic damage per slot level above 1.

jump.name: Jump
jump.components: V, S, M (a grasshopper's hind leg)
jump.description: You touch a creature. Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement (2024 revised to Bonus Action).

mage_armor.name: Mage Armor
mage_armor.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
mage_armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range without an attack roll or saving throw, dealing 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously. Upcasting: +1 dart per slot level above 1.

protection_from_evil_and_good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
protection_from_evil_and_good.components: V, S, M (holy water or powdered silver and iron)
protection_from_evil_and_good.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead: they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target, and target cannot be Charmed, Frightened, or Possessed by them.

ray_of_sickness.name: Ray of Sickness
ray_of_sickness.description: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, target takes 2d8 Poison damage and must make a CON save or gain the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.components: V, S, M (a small silver mirror)
sanctuary.description: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

shield_of_faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield_of_faith.components: V, S, M (a small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it)
shield_of_faith.description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.components: V, S, M (a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket)
sleep.description: Creatures in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw or gain the Incapacitated and Unconscious condition. (2024 revision from HP pool to Wisdom saving throw).

tashas_hideous_laughter.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
tashas_hideous_laughter.components: V, S, M (tiny tarts and a feather)
tashas_hideous_laughter.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall Prone, becoming Incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. Upcasting: +1d8 thunder damage per slot level above 1.

unseen_servant.name: Unseen Servant
unseen_servant.components: V, S, M (a piece of string and a bit of wood)
unseen_servant.description: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless, Medium force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends.

aid.name: Aid
aid.components: V, S, M (a tiny strip of white cloth)
aid.description: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration. Upcasting: +5 HP per slot level above 2.

barkskin.name: Barkskin
barkskin.components: V, S, M (a handful of oak bark)
barkskin.description: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus at the start of each of its turns (2024 buff).

blindness_deafness.name: Blindness/Deafness
blindness_deafness.description: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target gains the Blinded or Deafened condition for the duration (repeat save at end of each turn). Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 2.

blur.name: Blur
blur.description: Your body becomes blurred and shifting. For the duration, any creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you (unless it has blindsight or truesight).

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.components: V, M (bat fur and a drop of pitch)
darkness.description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. Nonmagical light cannot illuminate it, and darkvision cannot see through it.

enhance_ability.name: Enhance Ability
enhance_ability.components: V, S, M (fur or a feather)
enhance_ability.description: You touch a creature and bestow a magical enhancement: Bear's Endurance (+2d6 Temp HP, adv CON checks), Bull's Strength (adv STR checks, double carry capacity), Cat's Grace (adv DEX checks), Eagle's Splendor (adv CHA checks), Fox's Cunning (adv INT checks), Owl's Wisdom (adv WIS checks). Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 2.

find_steed.name: Find Steed
find_steed.description: You summon an otherworldly steed (Celestial, Fey, or Fiend) with AC 10+PB, HP 5+5xPaladin Level, Speed 60ft, Telepathic bond, and healing burst (2024 Paladin core class spell).

flaming_sphere.name: Flaming Sphere
flaming_sphere.components: V, S, M (a bit of sponge)
flaming_sphere.description: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet makes a DEX save, taking 2d6 Fire damage on failure. Move sphere up to 30ft as Bonus Action. Upcasting: +1d6 fire damage per slot level above 2.

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.components: V, S, M (a small, straight piece of iron)
hold_person.description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or gain the Paralyzed condition for the duration (repeat save at end of each turn). Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 2.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.components: V, S, M (an eyelash encased in gum arabic)
invisibility.description: A creature you touch gains the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early if the target attacks or casts a spell. Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 2.

lesser_restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser_restoration.description: You touch a creature and can end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned (2024 buff to Bonus Action).

misty_step.name: Misty Step
misty_step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
moonbeam.components: V, S, M (several seeds of moonseed and a piece of opalescent feldspar)
moonbeam.description: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 Radiant damage on failure. Move beam up to 60ft as a Bonus Action. Upcasting: +1d10 radiant damage per slot level above 2.

pass_without_trace.name: Pass without Trace
pass_without_trace.components: V, S, M (ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce)
pass_without_trace.description: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you. For the duration, each creature of your choice within 30 feet has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by magical means.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 Fire damage. Upcasting: +1 ray per slot level above 2.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.components: V, S, M (a chip of mica)
shatter.description: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has Disadvantage on this saving throw. Upcasting: +1d8 thunder damage per slot level above 2.

silence.name: Silence
silence.description: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature entirely inside the sphere is immune to Thunder damage and gains the Deafened condition; casting a spell with a Verbal component is impossible there.

spiritual_weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual_weapon.description: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration. When you cast the spell and as a Bonus Action on subsequent turns, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Force damage + your spellcasting ability modifier (2024 now requires Concentration). Upcasting: +1d8 force damage for every two slot levels above 2.

suggestion.name: Suggestion
suggestion.components: V, M (a snake's tongue and a bit of honeycomb)
suggestion.description: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature within range that can hear and understand you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw or pursue the suggested course of action.

web.name: Web
web.components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)
web.description: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube and count as Difficult Terrain. Each creature that starts its turn in the webs or enters them during its turn must make a Dexterity saving throw or gain the Restrained condition.

animate_dead.name: Animate Dead
animate_dead.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust)
animate_dead.description: This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range to animate as a Skeleton or Zombie.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. Target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell fails and its action is wasted, but the spell slot is not expended (2024 revision from ability check to Constitution saving throw).

dispel_magic.name: Dispel Magic
dispel_magic.description: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 + the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
fireball.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Upcasting: +1d6 fire damage per slot level above 3.

fly.name: Fly
fly.components: V, S, M (a wing feather from any bird)
fly.description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall. Upcasting: +1 target per slot level above 3.

haste.name: Haste
haste.components: V, S, M (a shaving of licorice root)
haste.description: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's Speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns (Attack [one weapon attack only], Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize). When the spell ends, the target can't move or take actions until after its next turn.

hypnotic_pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
hypnotic_pattern.components: S, M (a glowing stick of incense or a crystal vial filled with phosphorescent material)
hypnotic_pattern.description: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes Charmed for the duration. While Charmed by this spell, the creature is Incapacitated and has a Speed of 0.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass)
lightning_bolt.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Upcasting: +1d6 lightning damage per slot level above 3.

mass_healing_word.name: Mass Healing Word
mass_healing_word.description: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. (2024 buff from 1d4 to 2d4). Upcasting: +1d4 healing per slot level above 3.

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.components: V, S, M (diamonds worth 300 GP, which the spell consumes)
revivify.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

spirit_guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spirit_guardians.description: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. An affected creature's Speed is halved in the area, and when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 Radiant (or Necrotic) damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Upcasting: +1d8 damage per slot level above 3.
